people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: “At that time,” says Yahweh, “I will be the God of all the families of Israel, and they will be my people.”
translations.bsb: “At that time,” declares the LORD, “I will be the God of all the families of Israel, and they will be My people.”
translations.kjv: At the same time, saith the LORD, will I be the God of all the families of Israel, and they shall be my people.
translations.asv: At that time, saith Jehovah, will I be the God of all the families of Israel, and they shall be my people.
